messages:
morgan: Postmortem follow-up: consolidating action owners and short timelines for the DR + regional failover items. Drop confirms or blockers.

sam: Im taking the routing policy updates. Plan: add health-check gating and TTL 30s for critical records. ETA Fri COB.

ivana: Ill own restore runbook changes. Adding: sha256 verification, mount checks, and a 5-min smoke test script for auth and queues. PR by Mon.

anika: Ill schedule game-day ops. Proposing Apr 14 09:00-11:00 PT for the live dry-run, tabletop a week earlier. ops-bot please add tentative holds.

ops-bot: Tentative holds added: Tabletop 2026-04-07 09:00-10:00 PT; Dry-run 2026-04-14 09:00-11:00 PT.

derek: Ill run the S3 CRR + KMS audit. Found 2 buckets with replication disabled in eu-west-1 during quick scan. Target Thu EOD for the audit CSV and remediation script.

storage-bot: Alert: snapshot.merge.timeout on storage-node-7 earlier today. Logs saved to /incidents/3365400000.

morgan: RACI (short): Routing=R=sam,A=morgan,C=infra-net,I=platform; Restores=R=ivana,A=morgan,C=storage,I=oncall; CRR audit=R=derek,A=morgan,C=security,I=storage.

sam: Quick config example Ill include:
```yaml
route53:
  failover:
    primary: eu-west-1
    fallback: us-west-2
  health_check:
    path: /_live
    threshold: 2
    interval_s: 10
  ttl_s: 30
```

ivana: On smoke tests: prefer synthetic probes by default, small sampled replay for e2e validation. Ill add a canary replay script (max 100 requests).

anika: Tabletop agenda will include role play, escalation contacts, and a rollback drill. Will circulate invite when infra confirms availability.

derek: Audit command Im using: `aws s3api get-bucket-replication --bucket <name>` and will provide a patch script: `aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket <name> --replication-configuration file://rep.json`.

morgan: Please drop one-line status by EOD so I can publish the consolidated tracker to execs. If dates slip, update this thread.

sam: Status: drafted routing changes, need infra review.

ivana: Status: runbook draft in Confluence, PR Monday.

anika: Status: holds in calendar, infra to confirm.

derek: Status: audit in progress, found 2 buckets; remediation script coming Thu.

morgan: Exec summary (3 bullets): 1) routing fallbacks -> add health gating + TTL tuning; 2) snapshot merge timeouts under disk pressure -> pre-merge checks + alerts; 3) replication drift -> audit + remediation scripts. Will publish tracker tomorrow AM. Thanks.
